title: Unit – 5 : Session – 12 : SLO – 1  |  Documenting and Presenting a Python-Based Dissertation
sections: 1. Key parts of a project report — Abstract, Introduction (problem statement and objectives), Literature/Technology Survey, System Design (architecture, module diagram), Implementation (code, screenshots), Results and Testing, Conclusion and Future Work, References.

2. Presenting a Python project — start with the problem and chosen paradigm, show the architecture, give a live demo of the running program, walk through 2–3 key code sections, present test results, and close with limitations and future scope.

3. Why documentation matters — it lets others (and your future self) understand, reproduce, maintain and extend the project; it is also the primary artifact examiners evaluate for correctness of analysis, design and results.
